title: The burden of producing evidence
summary: The production burden requires enough evidence to permit a reasonable factfinder to decide an issue for the party who must prove it. At summary judgment, the movant also has an initial procedural responsibility to support the motion.
notes: A bare assertion that the opponent has no evidence is insufficient. Meeting the production threshold also does not guarantee persuasion at trial.

sections.Meaning: The production burden requires enough evidence to permit a reasonable factfinder to decide an issue for the party who must prove it. At summary judgment, the movant also has an initial procedural responsibility to support the motion.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the trial burden for the challenged element. A movant who lacks that trial burden may point to an adequately demonstrated absence of supporting evidence under Celotex. If the initial showing succeeds, the opponent must identify evidence creating a genuine dispute or seek appropriate discovery protection.
